WITH product_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    pc.product_type_description,
    AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity,
    COUNT(*) as order_item_count
  FROM Products p
  JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM Order_Items
),
product_metrics_with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    pm.*,
    CAST(pm.order_item_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / tc.total as share_of_items
  FROM product_metrics pm
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
),
product_type_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    product_type_description,
    AVG(avg_quantity) as avg_quantity_per_type,
    AVG(order_item_count) as avg_count_per_type,
    AVG(share_of_items) as avg_share_per_type
  FROM product_metrics_with_share
  GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_quantity_per_type) as overall_avg_quantity,
  AVG(avg_count_per_type) as overall_avg_count,
  AVG(avg_share_per_type) as overall_avg_share
FROM product_type_metrics;
